outputs.explanation: Panel A is a spatial cluster image, not a statistical plot, and contains no significance symbols.
Panel B shows H&E histology images with manual region annotations, not a statistical plot, and contains no significance symbols.
Panel C shows H&E histology and spatial gene-expression heatmap overlays, not a statistical significance plot, and contains no significance symbols.
The GSEA enrichment plots report exact NES, FDR, and p values directly on each plot rather than using symbolic significance indicators (e.g., asterisks), so there are no symbols requiring definition.
The bar graph reports exact p values above each bar rather than using significance symbols (e.g., asterisks), so there are no symbols requiring definition.
